name: hud_ui_panel_simple_constructor_default_thunk
description: HudUiPanelSimple::ConstructorDefaultThunk forwards to HudUiPanelSimple::Constructor with null text and zero position.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a HudUiPanelSimple class or HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40fab0 validates pushing null text, y 0, and x 0 before calling HudUiPanelSimple::Constructor, then returning with the constructor result.
0x40fac0 HudUiPanelSimple::Constructor is functionally equivalent under target hud_ui_panel_simple_constructor.
The native panel-simple constructor smoke calls ConstructorDefaultThunk and verifies it returns self, installs g_HudUiPanelSimple_FTable, initializes empty text, and sets x/y to zero.
